blocks.text: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump on Friday threatened “a tremendous tax” on U.S. companies that build artificial intelligence data centers abroad, highlighting a divide between a president who sees their expansion as critical to winning the AI race and an American public that is deeply skeptical of their benefits. Briefing reporters at the White House shortly after his return from Asia, the president said the country was ahead of China in developing what he likes to call “super intelligence.” But he warned it could fall behind if a growing political backlash puts the brakes on development of the data centers that […]...
